source_note: Public demonstration built from the corona benchmark, showing open-licensed material only: published Metaphor Menu entries and the CC-licensed #ReframeCovid collection, attributed to their contributors. Reddit text is not redistributed.
provenance_steps: 600 quality-filtered public posts from two COVID illness communities on Reddit (March 2020 - July 2021), split into 1,823 passages, with items of known status hidden among them: 17 published Metaphor Menu entries and 130 CC-licensed #ReframeCovid entries as known-good, and 100 figurative disease mentions about other topics as known-bad probes.

A local model family proposed metaphor candidates from every passage. A second model family independently checked whether each proposed phrase was metaphorical in its passage; 1,665 verified candidates went on to screening.
The workflow then recorded separate outputs for metaphor validity and illness relevance, lived experience, and resemblance to published Metaphor Menu entries (score 0-10).

Overlapping spans of the same expression were merged, and the four planted entries quoted inside the scoring prompt were removed: 1,490 ranked candidates, of which this demo shows the 415 with open-licensed text (Reddit text is not redistributed).
